requirements: R1: Patch TaskServicePatch.java to correctly update task status to 'failed' when a PR is closed without merge, addressing the root cause instead of hiding the log symptom (Finding 6).
R2: Update testSyncTaskStatusesDoesNotPerformRedundantUpdatesOnSubsequentRuns test to accurately assert the status reversion without faking success (Finding 7).

slices.title: Fix PR closed status sync logic and tests
slices.jtbd: When implementing the task status sync patch for this epic, I want to properly revert the status of tasks whose PRs are closed without merge, so that the system accurately reflects unmerged work.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with a PR closed on GitHub but not merged,
When the task status sync process executes,
Then the internal task status must be explicitly updated to 'failed',
And the unit test must genuinely assert this status reversion.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive done tasks from unmerged PRs from >0 to 0
